## Measured gaps

Offensive tests that run today without a detection. Each one is planned, not hidden.

| Test | ATT&CK | State | Planned |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ldap_enumeration](../red/active_directory/ldap_enumeration/) | [T1087.002](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1087/002/) | gap | A decoy-account rule (4662 read of a honeypot SPN user, which no legitimate process touches) and a hunt over 1644 for (servicePrincipalName=*) from workstations. |
| [privilege_escalation_checks](../red/linux/privilege_escalation_checks/) | [T1083](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1083/) | gap | A correlation over Sysmon for Linux process creation: find -perm -4000, getcap -r and sudo -l from one parent session within a short window, measured against a Linux administration baseline before it is enabled. |
| [file_upload_testing](../red/web/file_upload_testing/) | [T1505.003](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1505/003/) | gap | A WAF-log rule for executable or double extensions on upload endpoints, once a WAF log source is mapped. |
| [jwt_testing](../red/web/jwt_testing/) | [T1606](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1606/) | gap | A rule on application logs for JWT validation failures with algorithm none, once an application log source is mapped. |
| [security_headers_testing](../red/web/security_headers_testing/) | - | posture check | configuration review, no detection expected |

Cloud, email, WAF and network detections are not in the repository: the [roadmap](../docs/RELEASE_ROADMAP.md#after-v20-new-data-domains) lists the data each one needs first.
